rules: Any liquid asset: stock, crypto, or leveraged/inverse ETF
Rotate each 6:30am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Leverage matched to conviction; asymmetric payoff preferred
Hard stop at entry; spot-crypto-only on weekends

positions.name: ProShares UltraPro QQQ (3x Nasdaq-100)
positions.sector: Leveraged broad equity ETF — 3x long Nasdaq-100 (mega-cap tech)
positions.catalyst: July CPI prints today at 7:30am CT (8:30am EDT), squarely INSIDE this 24h hold window. Consensus: headline +0.1% m/m / 3.4% y/y (down from 3.5%), core +0.2% m/m / 2.5% y/y (down from 2.6%) — a disinflation read. Prediction markets (Kalshi) skew even softer: <55% odds CPI >3.3% y/y, only 15% >3.4%. Soft/in-line print raises Sept rate-cut odds and is risk-on for rate-sensitive mega-cap tech. Pre-market tape already leaning that way: QQQ +0.58% leading the majors, CoreWeave/SMCI up on earnings.
positions.driver: LONG 3x Nasdaq-100, 100% capital. Leverage matched to a STRONG, FRESH macro catalyst (CPI in-window) with a real directional edge — both consensus and prediction markets point to cooling inflation, and pre-market momentum confirms (QQQ leading, TQQQ +1.9% at 74.43 vs 73.06 close, well inside the chase band). Chosen over: SOXL (already +5.9% pre-market, stretched toward the chase cap and the falling-knife semis group that lost -8.9% recently); TNA (small caps lagging at +0.6%, tape not confirming the rate-cut trade yet); QLD (2x — same thesis but under-levered vs a catalyst this clean). TQQQ is the diversified mega-cap expression rather than the stretched semis. Entry 74.43 = Robinhood real-time pre-market ask (bid 74.42/ask 74.43, last 74.44) at ~11:43Z; dashboard proxy still echoing the 73.06 prior close pre-open, so used RH live per canonical fallback (same pattern documented yesterday on MARA). Stop 66.99 (-10%, 3x band).
positions.risks: Binary event risk: CPI is two-sided — a hot print (e.g. Apple hardware price hikes lifting core goods more than expected) reverses the risk-on trade hard, and 3x amplifies the downside. QQQ ~ -3.3% would trip the -10% stop. This is the opposite of a structurally asymmetric payoff; the edge rests on the disinflation lean, not certainty. Mitigants: -10% hard stop caps the loss; the print lands mid-window so the reaction is realized while we hold (not gapped over a rotation); pick is not a chase (+1.9%); Nasdaq is the most rate-sensitive, highest-quality high-beta expression rather than the stretched semis.
